  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The new FP_JOB_ID jq expression uses `capture("/check-runs/(?<id>[1-9][0-9]*)$")` without the `?` error-suppression operator, so a missing or non-matching `check_run_url` errors before the `// .id` fallback is reached.
  WHY: FP_JOB_ID ends up empty, the annotations fetch is skipped, and the failure-fingerprint marker is silently dropped (reason=annotations_unavailable). Severity disagreement: gemini=BLOCKER, minimax/luna=MAJOR; highest used. Disputed by anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, who say jq `capture` on no-match yields an empty stream with no error, so `// .id` falls back to the job's `.id` (22 in `_pff_jobs()`).

  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The duplicate-report guard (release_blocker_reported) is written to the local state file only after the heal dispatch succeeds, and it is persisted only through a best-effort `post_state_comment` write whose failure is suppressed with `|| true`.
  WHY: If the dispatch succeeds but the state-comment write fails, the next tick reloads state without the guard (line 15454; 6107-6114) and sends the same blocker report again, which violates the once-only requirement. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash says it is real but residual and degrades only to a duplicate report. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says it is the existing persistence model and the intake throttle absorbs duplicates.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:1142-1150 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new 180-second retired-label drain deadline (RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_DEADLINE_SECONDS) is checked only before each item, never during the item's API calls.
  WHY: `_github_api_request` retries with 120-second timeouts (266-279), so one retried request can take up to 360 s, and a worst-case item can take about 20 minutes. The job can exceed the 5-minute timeout in `.github/workflows/sync_ai_labels.yml:43` and be killed before it logs the clean `LABEL_SYNC_RETIRED_DRAIN_DEFERRED reason=budget` deferral. All three rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 considers it base-branch content outside this PR's scope.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:40-41, 1142-1143 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: No test covers the new drain-deadline behavior (RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_DEADLINE_SECONDS or the deadline break) or the STALL_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER_ENABLED truthy normalisation in .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2330-2332 and .github/workflows/plan.yml:3564-3566.
  WHY: Both behaviors can regress silently, contrary to the repo convention of pairing every script/workflow change with contract tests (NIT).
